producer_report.summary: Plans now carry a required `dependents` section. `PlanOutput` has the field with `#[serde(default)]`, and the JSON schema requires it. `JobPlan` stores it, skipped when empty, so old records parse and re-serialize byte for byte. `plan_findings` returns a Major finding, with no critic call, in three cases. The first is an empty list (location `dependents`, "no dependents section"). The second is an entry with a blank name or dependent ("Dependent N has a blank …"). The third is an entry with neither a non-blank test nor a non-blank reason; that finding names the entry. `plan_body` prints a "Dependents:" block only when the list is non-empty, so old plans render as before. `planner.md` gains the required bullet and `critic.md` gains the "what else does this change break" question, which tells the critic to check the list against a Grep. The helper `dependents_unnamed` plus a replay test show that a search for the changed behaviour turns up the seen-commands filter in `verify.rs`, and that the section is incomplete unless it names that rule. `refusal_corpus.rs` gets seven plan-side cases run through `plan_findings`. The scripted planners and `JobPlan` literals are updated. `docs/system-facts.md` budgets now read 966 for the planner and 902 for the critic. The CHANGELOG and `docs/design/job-planning.md` describe the change. Only the shape of the section is enforced in production; the repository search is a prompt rule and a replay test, and both the docs and the CHANGELOG say so.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test -p athena-core admission: plan_findings on a plan with no dependents (empty list) returns a Major finding naming the missing section; an entry with a blank name, or with neither test nor reason, returns a Major finding naming that dependent; a complete section adds no finding.
criteria_check.evidence: Three tests in the admission.rs test module: a_plan_with_no_dependents_is_a_major_finding_naming_the_missing_section, a_dependent_with_a_blank_name_or_neither_test_nor_reason_is_a_major_finding_naming_it, and a_complete_dependents_section_adds_no_finding. They drive plan_findings through dependents_findings_for, which varies only dependents. They passed in the athena-core run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test -p athena-core: a replay test for the CI-reuse case searches the real sources for the changed behaviour (exit_code) and shows the seen-commands filter in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs turns up, and the dependents requirement is unmet unless the section names that rule; the test fails if it is not named.
criteria_check.evidence: The test ci_reuse_replay_the_seen_commands_filter_turns_up_in_a_search_and_must_be_named in admission.rs walks the real athena-core/src for .rs files containing the needle, built from ["exit","code"].join("_") so the test does not match itself. It asserts verify.rs is a hit and still holds `c.reused && c.exit_code.is_none()`. dependents_unnamed leaves verify.rs unnamed for a section naming only checks.rs and the reused record, and drops it once an entry names verify.rs. It passed.

The nested-object count test went from 5 to 6. records.rs test plan_dependents_are_optional_in_old_records_and_round_trip_when_set checks the old bytes, the re-serialization and check_record_file. open_issues: I did not run the full `cargo test --locked` suite; I ran the changed crates, the athena-cli budgets, job_plan, introspection and lifecycle tests, clippy and the policy scan. Other athena-cli test files were not run and are left to Athena's checks.
Departure from the plan: the plan said lib.rs would change only if a test needed it; it did, because the 500-token frame bound failed for the planner frame, so I raised it to 700.

The production check is structural only (present, named, with a test or a reason). Whether the list covers every search hit is a prompt rule and a replay test, and nothing in production searches the repository. The docs and CHANGELOG say so.
mistakes: I first ran the budgets test before editing every scripted planner, which only cost one extra build; no wrong state was left.
learnings: plan_findings is the only place Athena's own plan checks live; a Major finding there sends the plan back with no critic call (RoundEnd::Mechanical), so the new rule needed no change to the planning loop.
Doc comments on the variants of a schemars enum would turn the schema's `enum` into a `oneOf`; the new DependentKindOutput therefore uses plain `//` comments to keep a string enum.
crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs has a test bound that each frame is under 500 tokens; the planner frame passed it only before this change.
docs/system-facts.md budget lines are checked against the computed sizes by crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs.
crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs builds no plan JSON; scripted plans fall back to the fake planner in athena-agent, so it needed no edit.
desires: A way to read a long test output file saved by the tool, or a quiet cargo flag by default, would have avoided a rerun.
